policy.title: Risk Management and Inter-Bank Dealings (FERR and NDDC hedging)

rules.title: NDDCs for hedging only
rules.description: AD Category-I banks with an operating IFSC Banking Unit may offer INR non-deliverable derivative contracts (NDDCs) to non-residents only for hedging.

citation.snippet: AD Category-I banks with an operating IFSC Banking Unit may offer INR non-deliverable derivative contracts (NDDCs) to non-residents only for hedging.

rules.title: Maintain the Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve
rules.description: AD Category-I banks shall maintain a Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve of 20% of the INR-equivalent notional of each FX derivative contract undertaken to hedge their own assets and liabilities, held as cash with RBI.
